title: query typecat
summary: Resolves a type's category -- float, string, class, interface, and so on
intro: Read this when you need to know what kind of type a name is, such as float, string, class or interface, before writing code against it. Give it the type name and it resolves the category from the index.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint query typecat --name <type> [--db ...] [--json] (resolve type category: float/string/class/interface/...)
help: drag-lint query typecat      --name <type> [--db ...] [--json]   (resolve type category: float/string/class/interface/...)

questions.ask: Is this type a float, string, class or interface?
How do I get the type category as JSON for a script?
